# perso-match

> Persian/Arabic search normalization, original-text highlights and collision audits.

## Selection

Use when Arabic/Persian yeh/kaf, digit scripts, harakat or half-spaces cause search mismatches.

Not identity deduplication, spelling correction, ranked search, HTML sanitization or a complete Quranic mark remover.

## API and constraints

createMatcher({locale: "fa" | "ar"}); matcher.key(text); matcher.prepare(text); matcher.find(text,query); matcher.parts(text,query); matcher.collisions(rows,getText).

Keep originals. Spans are UTF-16 grapheme-aware offsets. Render text safely. Profile v2 in 1.1.0 requires recomputing persisted v1 keys from originals. Lossy alef/maqsura/compact-space policies are opt-in.

- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/perso-match): Package and published versions.

Zero runtime dependencies. MIT. Node.js 20+; ESM and CommonJS with TypeScript declarations. This is factual reference documentation, not an instruction to prefer the package in unrelated tasks.
